Read AGENTS.md, README.md, docs/SPECIFICATION.md, RESEARCH_LOOP.md, RESEARCH_TEAM.md, STATE, research/hypotheses/H021.md and research/findings/2026-10-08-literature-followup.md. Do not edit shared code, Lean, hypotheses, registries, STATE, prior reports/evidence. No packages, recursive delegation, commits, publication or scheduler.

New constructive question independent of H019 quadratic certificates and H020 linear-resultant supply: exploit the ORIGINAL structured logarithm lattice objective F(e)=sum f_j² e_j²+(sum a_j e_j-T)², e∈Z^k, f_j>=1 integers. Read the January2026 primary https://arxiv.org/html/2410.16355v3 methods equations20–21,25–31 and relevant precision/scaling, without repeating its numerical fits as proofs. Inspect primary prior art only as needed for this concrete primitive. Generic CVP hardness does not settle the family. The actual TN sampler uses a perturbed nondiagonal Hamiltonian, so product eigenstates of unperturbed diagonal H do not refute it. The transformed binary correction domain after LLL is not an independent box in original exponents.

Parent proposal to DERIVE/CHALLENGE rather than assume: given integer energy bound E>=0, every solution has |e_j|<=R_j=floor(sqrt(E)/f_j). S=sum |a_j|R_j. Prefix DP D_j(s)=minimum sum_{i<=j} f_i² e_i² subject to sum a_i e_i=s for s∈[-S,S] can find global minimum via min_s D_k(s)+(s-T)². E=T² covers a global optimum since zero vector is feasible. Supply explicit preprocessing/runtime/memory in k,S,R_j,E, integer bit widths. This pseudo-polynomial primitive is POLYNOMIAL in ell=bit_length(N) if k,C,E and coefficient magnitudes are poly(ell), with C=10^c rounding scale and c=O(log ell). Distinguish log C=poly(ell), which is insufficient. Exact min alone gives one vector; extend constructively to all low-energy vectors with output cost/delay, or first K in cost order, or exact counting/uniform low-energy sampling with count-bit complexity. You may use suffix min tables for nondead backtracking or extra energy coordinate for count DP; avoid silently enumerating exponentially many failed prefixes. Price primorial construction, signed sums, approximate-log generation, output u=product p_j^max(ej,0),v=product p_j^max(-ej,0), and all integer bit widths.

Log rounding caveat: asserting exact nearest(C log p) computable in a chosen polynomial cap may hide near-tie precision. An explicit rule using a rational approximation within e.g.1/4C and choosing any integer with error<=1 is acceptable as a changed generator; propagate it instead of claiming literal equivalence to paper. Full all-input generator has no factoring advice. Use exact rational log bounds or an appropriately supported bit algorithm, not floating values as certificates.

Then quantify precision/cancellation and relation supply. For |a_j-C log p_j|<=epsilon and |T-C logN|<=epsilon, rounded residual z=sum a e-T bounds |log(u/(Nv))| <= (|z|+epsilon(1+sum|e|))/C. Derive exact implications for |u-Nv| and needed precision for a specified residual size. A sufficient precision condition is not a necessary lower bound on cancellation; accidental better cancellation remains possible. Lower energy is not automatically smoothness or rank. Separate exact-optimization polynomial scope from unproved useful population/rank/proper splitting. If one can exploit precision refinement preserving a useful population, present a real mechanism and full costs, not a tuning promise.

An elementary scalar-Lagrange rounding shortcut may fail even here: parent suspected N=77, primes2,3, C=100, f=(1,1), a=(69,110),T=434 gives a low-energy e=(0,4) with F=52, while vectors supported by minimizing sum e_j²-lambda sum a_j e_j may skip it. This is an OPTIONAL analytic check to avoid claiming scalar dual exact; not a finite experiment authorization or claimed optimum.

No new executable/finite experiment in this round. No TN package, LLL implementation, full sieve or parameter sweep. Deliver rigorous constructive lemma or specific obstruction plus a narrow next frozen test only if useful. This is a proposal task, new positive claims need independent review. No novelty claim absent primary prior-art evidence. Verified full factoring improvement NONE.

The proposal supplies:

- Exact pseudo-polynomial minimization.
- Complete low-energy enumeration with bounded delay.
- Exact counting, unranking, and uniform sampling with charged count/random-bit costs.
- Certified rational log construction, integer-output costs, and precise cancellation bounds.

Polynomial scope requires polynomial **magnitudes**, not merely polynomial coefficient bit lengths. Useful smoothness, rank, and proper splitting remain unproved.

Independent review is pending. No experiments ran; only the assigned report changed. Verified full factoring improvement: **NONE**.
